body_markdown:
## Stack Chats Episode 5: Bringing Stablecoin Payments to Latam with Andres Junge


**Guest:** Andres Junge, Founder,[Anyenk](https://anyenk.com/)


**Host:** Pelle Braendgaard, CEO & Co-Founder, Notabene


**Topics:** Stablecoins, Payments Infrastructure, Compliance, Interoperability, Latin America


In this episode of Stack Chats, Notabene CEO Pelle Braendgaard sits down with Andres Junge of Anyenk to discuss brining B2B stablecoin payments to Latam with Notabene Flow.
